title: OpenFresnel client boundary document

claims.text: The document states that the OpenFresnel receiver command ABI is AUSENTE and that the client validates arguments then refuses with internal without publication.
The configuration section defines the selection order of commands_dir: explicit argument, LINEAGE_OPENFRESNEL_COMMANDS_DIR environment value, then paths.commands_dir in the named contract file.
The argument contract section requires caller-asserted agent and op_id, forbids unknown fields such as rid and argv, and bounds timeout_ms to 1..60000 with default 20000.
The required publication section describes the <rid>.tmp, <rid>.json and <rid>.result.json protocol filenames and the fsync-before-rename publication sequence as blocked until an ABI exists.

triggers: spawn mode envelope versus endpoint confusion

decision.rule: Change here when the OpenFresnel client boundary, its configuration sources, argument contract or publication protocol needs to change.
decision.failure: The bridge refuses every call, an invalid configuration source is selected, or a spawn request carries both envelope and endpoint.

questions.q: Where is the configuration selection order for commands_dir documented?
Where should I check why openfresnel_spawn refuses with internal?
What argument fields does the bridge reject, such as rid or argv?
Which publication steps are blocked until the command ABI is supplied?
